name: avatar
behavior: Presentational identity image; no APG pattern (img semantics with alt text, or aria-hidden when adjacent text already names the person)

parts.note: square; size axis binds both dimensions to control-height-*
aspect-ratio 1; shown only after successful load
initials text, or the user icon role when no initials; rendered while image is absent or failed
wrapper for stacked avatars: members overlap by a fraction of avatar size (negative inline spacing — a recipe, not a token) and each gets a surface-colored ring to separate from neighbors

anatomyNotes: shadcn rounds full via radius-pill; Salt's square avatar is the same anatomy with the theme binding radius-pill differently — shape is a theme decision, not anatomy.
